newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude closes slightly lower.

text.p: IPE Brent futures closed slightly lower in line with a weaker gas oil market which shed $6 a tonne after U.S. inventory data showed a sharp build in distillates stocks.
December Brent closed 16 cents down at $23.58 a barrel. It sank to $23.35 a barrel during the morning session after the IPE bore the brunt of the bearish API data on distillates.
It later bounced back as some short-covering and some buy stops lifted the market higher during the afternoon session. Unleaded gasoline was the main market prop.

"Gasoline has been resilient, adding some stability to an otherwise aimless market," a futures broker said. "If we get another week of builds in heat, then people are going to start getting more concerned."
Earlier, November gas oil futures closed $6 a tonne lower at $217.25 a tonne.
The American Petroleum Institute said on Tuesday that total distilate supplies grew 3.6 million barrels for the week ended October 25.
Heating oil stocks gained 1.6 million barrels with distillate production at a record 3.8 million barrels a day.
